shared_elements: glyph blocks arranged in a grid
rectangular cartouche-like signs with rounded corners
horizontal register/band of glyphs at the top
carved relief on an upright slab (stela format)
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing rows of rounded-cornered glyph blocks in a grid, with B's top register of such signs closely matching A's entire glyphic field in form and layout, a fairly specific shared convention. The decisive difference is that B is dominated by two elaborately costumed standing human figures in profile facing each other with plumed headdresses and staffs, whereas A shows only text with no figural scene at all.
